title: Fail closed on unsafe config saves
summary: Move unsafe settings save enforcement into backend save paths and keep WebView/static tests aligned with backend-owned config policy.
reason: Settings Wizard and Save Patch could preview risks without consistently failing closed before config writes, and WebView POST scanning did not include apiPostLocal wrapper calls.
behavior_before: Dangerous wizard toggles could rely on preview warnings, settings patch could stage new unknown keys, and lifecycle smoke wrappers depended on an external PYTHONPATH.
behavior_after: Wizard save blocks unacknowledged dangerous toggles, settings patch rejects new unknown keys and source-mutation-looking changes while preserving loaded unknown keys, apiPostLocal routes are scanned, and lifecycle smoke wrapper sets PYTHONPATH.
manual_validation: PYTHONPATH=src; python -B -m unittest tests.python.desktop.test_settings_wizard_policy tests.python.desktop.test_application_facade_settings_patch tests.webview.test_webview_frontend_mutation_boundary tests.python.desktop.test_config_keys => 58 tests OK
rollback_plan: Revert the touched config save-path, WebView mutation-boundary test, smoke wrapper, and generated-summary changes in this packet; rerun the focused unittest group and WebView/Tauri smokes after rollback.
